Name: Gateway of India
Notes: Built 1924 to commemorate a royal visit; overlooks the Arabian Sea

Name: Marine Drive
Notes: 3.6 km seafront promenade known as the Queen's Necklace

Name: Elephanta Caves
Area: Elephanta Island (ferry from Gateway of India)
Notes: UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut cave temples, 5th-8th century

Name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
OpeningHours: Exterior viewing at all hours; active railway station
Notes: UNESCO World Heritage Victorian Gothic railway station, built 1887

Name: Siddhivinayak Temple
Notes: Prominent Lord Ganesha temple; major pilgrimage site

Name: Britannia & Co.
Notes: Historic Parsi restaurant est. 1923; known for berry pulao and dhansak

Name: Noor Mohammadi
Notes: Known for Chicken Sanju Baba and kebab thalis

Name: Oye Kake
